title: Genres by profit and share
statementMd:
For each genre with known financials, show total profit (gross minus budget) and its share of all profit as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `genre`, `profit`, `share_pct`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH g AS (SELECT genre, SUM(gross_millions - budget_millions) AS profit FROM movies WHERE gross_millions IS NOT NULL AND budget_millions IS NOT NULL GROUP BY genre) SELECT genre, ROUND(profit, 1) AS profit, ROUND(100.0 * profit / SUM(profit) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct FROM g;
```
